title: What EV charging with VOOL costs
description: The three parts of the cost: hardware, installation and software. What is free, what is charged, and which grants reduce the bill.

sections.title: Three parts: hardware, installation and software
sections.lead: Hardware is bought once from a reseller. Installation is quoted by a local partner. The software is free until VOOL collects money for you.

€2.50 a month or €24 a year per device, incl. VAT. Not needed with Wi-Fi or cable.

sections.note: No fixed monthly fee and no fee per charger for the software.

items.title: No grid upgrade
items.text: Load management usually removes the largest cost of a shared installation: a bigger connection.

items.title: Estonia: KIK grant
items.text: A 10-point installation in an apartment building gets €14,090 in grant.

items.title: Lithuania: DAEI income
items.text: Get paid for every kWh you charge at home.

items.title: Sweden, Portugal and others

items.title: Build in stages
